DEL course cover collection: 52 templates

Real covers from the new server renderer, each with a sample course title. The 16 newest are generic designs that fit any course, marked “New”. Every cover shares the site’s font, a topic label and the DevOps Easy Learning mark, so every course looks like it belongs to the same marketplace. Instructors pick one; the title is placed and sized automatically.

Generic: fits any course 16 templates

Abstract designs not tied to a technology: waves, blueprint, stripes, geometric shapes, arcs, dot grids, blocks and a minimal type-led cover. Good for soft skills, management, careers, languages, or any topic.

AI and machine learning 13 templates

Neural networks, AI chips, LLM chat, embeddings and RAG, attention, agents with tools, circuits and data.

IT and infrastructure 15 templates

Servers, databases, networks, APIs, containers, Kubernetes clusters, cloud, terminals and security.

DevOps and general tech 8 templates

The DEL loop, delivery pipelines, Git branches, metrics and architecture.

Long and short titles fit automatically

The title is measured with the real font: largest size that fits, clean line breaks, and a title longer than the space ends with “…” instead of overflowing.

What happens after you approve

  • Templates are stored in the database; a super admin can rename, recolour, re-tag, reorder, deactivate or add templates.
  • Instructors choose a cover in the studio with a live preview of their own title; the picker shows templates for the course’s topic first, then generic ones, then the rest. Changes go live at once, even on published courses, without touching videos.
  • Every existing course gets a template matched to its topic; the video-frame cover of “AI for DevOps” is replaced; custom cover uploads are removed.
  • Covers are real images, regenerated automatically when the title or template changes, and shown everywhere: home, catalogue, course page, deals, search, My learning and dashboards.
